Subject: Vendor onboarding: PO fields + early-pay options

Hi Jonas,

Thanks for the quick intro last week. We are ready to start the onboarding process for Novapulse as a Redwood supplier. Before we complete our intake form, two items we need to confirm so our AR team can plan: 1) the exact PO header fields Redwood requires (PO number format, line-item codes, tax flags, and whether you support a separate remit-to on the invoice), and 2) whether Redwood evaluates early-pay participation during onboarding (we're interested in a pilot for a 1.75% discount if paid within 15 days).

Attached are our W-9 and a bank ACH stub for ACH remittance. We can also upload invoice samples if you prefer the portal. Can you confirm:
- Required PO header fields and any accepted CSV/EDI schema?
- Whether you require invoices to be routed to invoices@redwood.com or via SFTP?
- How Redwood stages early-pay pilots (criteria, minimum volume, legal approval lead time)?

If helpful, Carlos from our finance team can join a short call to walk through the file layout. Proposed availability: Thu 11/19 between 10–12 PT.

Thanks,

Lily Chen
Head of Finance Operations
Novapulse, Inc.

Lily — thanks for sending these. Looping in Marissa (procurement) and Kimberly (finance) so we can confirm the exact intake requirements and early-pay program flow.

Quick answers up front: we support both email and SFTP invoice ingestion (SFTP is preferred for high volume partners). We need PO number, line-item SKU, quantity, unit price, tax indicator, and a remit-to block if different from bill-to. We also have a PO custom-field for CustomerProjectCode when requested by the buyer.

Marissa/Kim — can you confirm the canonical CSV header we should ask them to match and any legal/DocuSign items required to enable early-pay?

Lily — I can do Thu 11/19 10:30 PT for a quick screen-share if that works.

Regards,
Jonas Weber
Senior Partnerships Manager, Redwood Inference

From: marissa.cole@redwood.com

Subject: RE: Vendor onboarding: PO fields + early-pay options

Hi Lily — welcome. A few procurement notes and the canonical field mapping we need:

Required invoice/PO fields (CSV header we validate on intake):
- PO_Number (string)
- Line_Number (int)
- Item_Description (string)
- SKU (string)
- Quantity (decimal)
- Unit_Price (decimal)
- Tax_Indicator (Y/N)
- BillTo_Name
- RemitTo_Name
- RemitTo_Address_Line1
- RemitTo_Account_Number (if different)
- CustomerProjectCode (optional)

Notes:
- If Novapulse sends consolidated invoices (one invoice covering multiple POs), include PO_Number as a repeated field and a PO_Count header.
- Preferred invoice ingestion: SFTP drop (sftp://invoices.redwood.com/novapulse). If you prefer email, send to invoices@redwood.com with the PO_Number in the subject line.
- Please add "Tax Exempt" flag where applicable and include supporting certificate when tax exempt.

Attachment: po_field_sample.csv (format example) and vendor_intake_checklist.pdf — please fill and return.

On early-pay: we run eligibility checks (minimum monthly invoice volume and credit/risk check) and require a signed vendor early-pay addendum (DocuSign). Kimberly — I defer to you for the approval thresholds.

If Thu 10:30 PT works, I'll join as well.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Lead, Procurement Operations
Redwood Inference
attachments: po_field_sample.csv; vendor_intake_checklist.pdf

From: kimberly.park@redwood.com

Subject: RE: Vendor onboarding: PO fields + early-pay options

Lily — I pulled the preliminary numbers. Quick summary of our early-pay pilot framework and what we need from Novapulse to progress:

1) Eligibility criteria (baseline):
- Minimum monthly invoiced volume: $50k
- Clean remittance history (no more than 1 disputed invoice in last 12 months)
- Valid ACH details and W-9 on file

2) Pilot commercial options we typically consider (subject to FP&A sign-off):
- 1.5% discount if paid in 15 days (Net15)
- 0.8% discount if paid in 10 days (Net10)

3) Timeline:
- Run credit/risk check (2 business days)
- Legal DocuSign (vendor addendum) — typically 3 business days for signature
- If approved, first pilot payments processed within next AR cycle (usually within 30–45 days)

Action items for Novapulse:
- Return the vendor intake checklist, completed.
- Send monthly invoice volume estimate and sample 3 months of invoice history (CSV).
- Confirm preferred discount option for pilot.

DocuSign link: https://docusign.com/abcdef12345 (this is the vendor addendum – please sign to enable early-pay terms).

I'll run the risk check once we have the checklist and invoice history. Happy to review proposed commercial terms after that.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Manager, Accounts Payable
Redwood Inference
